values.note: Full hookups by site, tax included: sites 6-11 $40, 19-21 $41.50, 12-18 $42.50, 1-5 and 15 $43, 22-24 $44. Rate covers two people, one RV and one vehicle; children in school free. Discounts for 5-day, 7-14 day and 30+ night stays (30+ nights 65% off with metered electric); veteran discount for two nights; hunter discount in bow season.

note: Small wooded park of gravel back-ins on Highway 8 near St. James, two miles from Maramec Spring Park. RVs must be self-contained; the shower building is for tent, pop-up, truck and van campers. Strict site rules (working RV components, nothing stored outside, photo ID and vehicle registration at check-in). --Claude
summary: Operator pages: full hookups $40-44 with tax included, 2 people + 1 vehicle, extra adult $3.50, extra vehicle $2; 24 back-in sites, 50A on 1-5/12-18; open year-round (some sites Apr-Nov); phone booking 12 months out, holiday 3-night minimum. Added tax/extra_person/extra_vehicle, season and sites. Google 4.9/149, RV Life 4.5*/21.

PRICE GATE: $40-44/night with tax included (full hookups), under US$50. Google Maps 4.9 over 149; RV Life 4.5* over 21. Camper reports: RV Life 9/2026 and 8/2026 $35 (military), 1/2025 $42, 9/2025 $50.

Long-stay: the operator discounts 30+ night stays (65% off with metered electric) but says 'We are not a mobile park for permanent residence'; reviews read as overnighters. Nightly rate posted on its own site with a phone (test 2 PASS); holiday-only minimum (test 3 PASS); no booking engine for an occupancy check (the RoverPass booking link is unclaimed - no Instant Book or Request to Book). Not long-stay in character; keep.

Facility caveat for a motorhome: RVs must be self-sufficient - the shower/restroom building is only for tent, pop-up, truck and van campers (an RV Life 9/2025 reviewer: 'They had no bath house'). Reserve page still headed 'RESERVATIONS for 2024'; the rates page is undated (read 2026-11-08).
Website: pheasantacresrv.com (the stored www. URL redirects there) - fine.
